items.description: The job search that runs on your machine. AI job application framework built on Claude Code: evaluate postings, tailor CVs, write cover letters, prep interviews. Fork it and own it.
items.author: MadsLorentzen
items.summary_zh: MadsLorentzen/ai-job-search 是一个基于 Claude Code 的 AI 求职申请框架，代码在本机运行，用户 fork 后填入个人资料即可让 AI 评估职位、定制简历、写求职信和准备面试。项目强调 open source 且与 Anthropic 无关，只是用 Claude Code 作为工作流工具。适合正在海投或想自动化求职流程的开发者。
items.summary_en: MadsLorentzen/ai-job-search is an AI-powered job application framework built on Claude Code that runs locally on your machine. After forking the repo and filling in your profile, Claude evaluates job postings, tailors your CV, writes cover letters, and prepares you for interviews. It is an independent open-source project, not affiliated with Anthropic.

items.title: Cursor 转 Codex 大半个月，聊聊我的真实感受
items.description: Cursor 让我第一次强烈感受到 AI 编程的震撼，Codex 则让我第一次真正感觉到，AI 不只是编程助手，而是一个真正的超级Agent，Codex 明显更接近下一阶段的形态。
items.summary_zh: 这是一篇掘金文章，作者记录了自己从 Cursor 切换到 Codex、持续使用大半个月后的真实体验。在他看来，Cursor 让他第一次强烈感受到 AI 编程的价值，而 Codex 更像一个能自主完成任务的超级 Agent，而不只是编程助手，形态更接近下一阶段。适合正在做 AI 编程工具选型的开发者。
items.summary_en: A Juejin post by a developer who switched from Cursor to Codex and has used it for roughly half a month. Cursor, the author says, was his first strong taste of what AI coding can do, while Codex feels less like a coding assistant and more like an autonomous super-agent, closer to the next stage of tooling. Useful for developers weighing which AI coding tool to adopt.

items.title: Akka 在 65 个开源项目中测试基于规格的 AI 交付
items.summary_zh: Akka 在 65 个开源项目上实测了一套基于规格说明的 AI 辅助移植流程，首轮耗时 99.3 小时、消耗 94.1 亿 token，其中 57 个项目在代码行数或性能上有改善。实现与审查由 Claude 配合 Akka Specify 完成，Sonnet 平均每个移植 61 分钟，Opus 要 120 分钟但 token 少约四成。关注 AI 辅助大规模代码迁移的团队可以看看。
items.summary_en: Akka ran a spec-driven AI porting workflow across 65 open source projects, spending 99.3 hours and 9.41 billion tokens in the first round; 57 of the ports improved either line count or performance. Claude worked with Akka Specify on implementation and review, with Sonnet averaging 61 minutes per port versus 120 for Opus, which used roughly 40% fewer tokens. Relevant for teams weighing AI-assisted large-scale code migration.

items.title: [分享创造] [开源&极重] Kokoro 探针 1.0 版发布，你没用过的博客式探针
items.summary_zh: Kokoro 探针 1.0 以 AGPL-3.0 开源，采用 Hub 主控加 Agent 探针的架构，提供 Linux amd64/arm64 预编译包，主控用一条脚本装在 Debian/Ubuntu + systemd 上。除三网探测与告警外，它还支持面板下发测试、给小鸡点赞留言和写介绍文章、一键备份迁移、远程加 SWAP，并能把主题范例丢给 AI 生成新主题。适合自己折腾 VPS 监控面板的人。
items.summary_en: Kokoro Probe 1.0 is an AGPL-3.0 monitoring panel built as a hub plus agent, shipping prebuilt Linux amd64/arm64 binaries and a one-line installer for Debian/Ubuntu with systemd. Beyond three-network latency checks and alerts, it offers panel-triggered tests, per-VPS likes, comments and Markdown write-ups, one-click backup and migration, remote SWAP expansion, and theme samples you can hand to an AI to generate new themes. Aimed at people running their own VPS dashboards.

items.title: 面试官问你：“AI 能写 80% 的代码了，公司为什么还需要你？”
items.description: 先说一个事实：2026 年的技术面试，已经和两年前完全不一样了。两年前面试问的是："手写一个 Promise"、"说说 React Fiber 原理"...现在面试官默认你会用 AI。他们真正想知道的
items.summary_zh: 这篇掘金文章讨论 2026 年技术面试的变化：两年前还在考手写 Promise、React Fiber 原理，如今面试官默认候选人会用 AI，转而追问「AI 能写 80% 的代码，公司为什么还需要你」。文章要回答的正是开发者该展示哪些 AI 替代不了的判断力和工程能力，适合正在准备面试的工程师。
items.summary_en: A Juejin post on how 2026 technical interviews differ from two years ago: instead of hand-writing a Promise or explaining React Fiber, interviewers now assume candidates already use AI and ask why a company should still hire them when AI writes 80% of the code. It's aimed at engineers preparing for interviews who need to articulate what AI can't replace.

items.title: The World Is Not a Dataset - Building AI Systems That Continuously Learn from Reality｜QCon上海
items.summary_zh: 蚂蚁灵波科技首席数据科学家黄用韬将在 10 月 22-24 日的 QCon 上海站分享《The World Is Not a Dataset》，指出机器人学习不能只围绕静态数据集，任务创建、人工介入、失败与标定等上下文都属学习系统的一部分。他主张以端、边、云协同把问题发现、数据产生、模型学习与评测串成闭环，让数据集成为持续学习的结果而非起点。
items.summary_en: At QCon Shanghai (October 22-24), Huang Yongtao, chief data scientist at Ant Lingbo Technology and a former tech partner at DeepRoute.ai, will argue in "The World Is Not a Dataset" that robot learning cannot be built around static datasets, since task setup, human intervention, failures and recalibration are all part of the learning system. He proposes an end-edge-cloud loop linking problem discovery, data collection, training and evaluation, so datasets become an output of continual learning rather than its starting point.

The roundup covers the Jakarta EE 12 schedule for each profile, Eclipse JNoSQL's promotion from incubation to an EE4J project, and JobRunr 9.0.0, which adds a Gantt-chart view of job lifecycles to its dashboard.

items.title: [分享创造] [开源] 做了个本地 AI 小说写作工具，把伏笔和正文连起来
items.summary_zh: 「玄印写作」是一个免费开源的本地桌面写作工具，0.1 版本支持 Windows x64 和 M 系列 Mac，作品保存在自选本地目录，无需注册账号，成稿可导出 TXT、Markdown、DOCX、PDF。它的重点是把伏笔管理从笔记和聊天窗口里拉回来：每条伏笔可记录状态、计划回收章节，并关联到正文原句，点击就能跳回出处，需要自备文本模型 API Key 让 AI 协助登记。适合写长篇、需要跨章节回收线索的作者，但目前没有云同步和完整备份，安装包也未签名。
items.summary_en: Xuanyin Writing is a free, open-source desktop tool for long-form fiction, now at version 0.1 for Windows x64 and Apple-silicon Macs. Drafts live in a local folder you choose, no account needed, and export to TXT, Markdown, DOCX or PDF. Its hook is foreshadowing management: each planted thread records its status, planned payoff chapter and the exact source sentence, so you can jump back to the passage instead of grepping for keywords. You supply your own model endpoint and API key for the AI-assisted bookkeeping. No cloud sync or full backup yet, and the installer is unsigned.

items.title: [分享发现] 坦桑尼亚首款招聘 APP — Jobsoko 上线半年

items.summary_en: Jobsoko, a recruitment app launched in Dar es Salaam, Tanzania, went live on Google Play and the App Store in June and has now run for about half a year. The author says the business is not yet clearly profitable but that the local market is starting to accept the product. He notes he passed on gold-mining and real-estate opportunities there to pursue outbound digitalization instead, and credits local Chinese expats and partners. It reads as a founder's note; no user or listing numbers are given.

items.title: [科幻] 太空版人生游戏：光年卡农
items.summary_zh: 「光年卡农」是一个太空题材的人生模拟游戏，由长期做硬科幻世界观项目「星际移民中心」的作者和朋友们用 Claude 协助开发，背景设定在未来约五百年：人类先开发太阳系，再通过脉冲星拍频信号与远方文明建立通信，随后出现可传送小物件乃至载人的 Krasnikov tube。玩法是随机出生、在历史事件中做选择、死亡后由后代或他人接续你的路线，人生交错延后如同卡农。团队偏理工与艺术背景，作者是理论物理 PhD，部分设定为推进叙事做了简化。
items.summary_en: Light-Year Canon is a life-simulation game set roughly five centuries ahead, built with Claude by the team behind the long-running hard sci-fi worldbuilding project Interstellar Migration Center. Its setting moves from solar-system development to contact via a pulsar beat-frequency signal, then to Krasnikov tubes that first carry small objects and later people. You are born at random, make choices during historical events, die, and continue through descendants or others, with overlapping lives echoing a canon. The team includes a theoretical physics PhD, though some physics is simplified to keep the story moving.

items.summary_en: A short promotional post: the author noticed Kanye West's "Closed on Sunday" gaining traction on TikTok and points to closedonsundayai.net, a site he says can do AI video replacement/swapping and that he found easy to use. Beyond that subjective impression, the post gives no detail on what the tool actually does, how it is priced, or how it handles uploaded footage, so treat it as an unvetted recommendation rather than a review.

items.title: “AI+终端”时代的萌芽：大模型在终端领域的探索和量产落地｜QCon上海
items.summary_zh: 阶跃星辰 AI 终端解决方案架构师袁俊杰将在 2026 年 10 月 22-24 日的 QCon 上海站分享大模型在终端侧的探索与量产落地，归属「千行百业 Agent 创新实践」专题。内容覆盖车端、手机、可穿戴、智能家居和 IoT 的场景现状，以及替代 ASR→NLU→DM→TTS 级联方案的 Realtime Voice Agent 端到端流式架构，目标把端到端延迟压到 200ms 以内并支持随时打断。他此前参与过阶跃 Step、Moonshot、盘古等模型的早期商业化，主导阶跃模型在汽车及终端从 0 到百万量的落地。
items.summary_en: At QCon Shanghai (October 22-24, 2026), StepFun AI terminal solutions architect Yuan Junjie will talk about running large models on devices rather than in the cloud, covering automotive cockpits, phones, wearables, smart home and IoT. The core technical pitch is a Realtime Voice Agent architecture that replaces the cascaded ASR, NLU, dialogue-manager and TTS pipeline with end-to-end streaming, targeting under 200ms latency with mid-utterance interruption. He has worked on early commercialization for Step, Moonshot and PanGu models and led StepFun deployments from zero to a million units.

items.summary_en: IDC's Q2 data puts worldwide server revenue at $166.3 billion, up 52% year over year, while x86 grew just 16% and non-x86 jumped 146%, with GPU-equipped machines now at 52.6% of the market. The poster, who works in server maintenance, says new budgets mostly go to GPU systems, so aging x86 fleets keep getting stretched — even though agents still run their tools on ordinary CPUs.

items.title: Meta 联手苹果推出全美最强开源模型，编码基测输给智谱、Kimi

items.summary_en: Meta released the open weights of Muse Spark Open on October 15: a sparse mixture-of-experts model with 816B total parameters and roughly 42B active per token, taking text, images, audio and video as input. It targets agentic software engineering, yet trails GLM 5.3 max and Kimi K3 max on Terminal-Bench 2.1 and DeepSWE 1.1. Local deployment needs two M5 Ultra Mac Studios.

items.title: Cloudflare 修复了容器中的跨租户数据泄露问题
items.summary_zh: Cloudflare 披露并修复了 Containers 平台的跨租户数据泄露漏洞：容器磁盘由 dm-thin 按 64 KiB 块精简分配，且跳过清零，一次 4 KiB 写入后剩余空间可能残留其他租户的数据。研究员 Oren Yomtov 于 9 月 4 日经漏洞赏金计划报告该问题，他在 5614 个可测试目录块中读到的全部是他人数据，还恢复出完整 SQLite 数据库；Cloudflare 称未发现恶意利用。
items.summary_en: Cloudflare disclosed and fixed a cross-tenant data leak in its Containers platform, which also backs Cloudflare Sandboxes. Container disks are thinly provisioned by dm-thin in 64 KiB blocks with zeroing skipped, so a 4 KiB write could leave roughly 60 KiB of a previous tenant's data readable. Researcher Oren Yomtov reported it on September 4; all 5,614 testable directory blocks across six production deployments came from other users. Cloudflare says it found no evidence of exploitation.

items.title: akitaonrails/ai-memory
items.description: Solution for long term memory for agent coding CLIs and to facilitate handoff between different agent vendors
items.author: akitaonrails
items.summary_zh: ai-memory 是一个用 Rust 编写的开源工具（MIT 协议，要求 Rust 1.95+），为 Claude Code、OpenAI Codex 等编码 agent 提供长期记忆，让任务做到一半换工具时不必重新交代架构、失败过的方案和待解问题。它针对的是各家内置记忆绑定单机、单一 agent、切换工具或交接给同事后就失效的问题。
items.summary_en: ai-memory is an MIT-licensed Rust tool (Rust 1.95+) that gives coding agents such as Claude Code and OpenAI Codex a shared long-term memory, so you can quit one mid-task and pick up in another without re-explaining the architecture, the failed approaches or the open questions. It targets a common limit: built-in memory features live on one machine, belong to one agent, and vanish when you switch tools or hand off to a teammate.

items.title: headroomlabs-ai/headroom
items.description: Compress tool outputs, logs, files, and RAG chunks before they reach the LLM. 20% fewer tokens for coding agents, 60-95% fewer tokens for JSON, same answers. Library, proxy, MCP server.
items.author: headroomlabs-ai
items.summary_zh: Headroom 是一个位于 LLM 之前的上下文压缩层，在工具输出、日志、文件和 RAG 片段送入模型前先做压缩，以库、代理和 MCP server 三种形式提供。据项目方数据，编码 agent 可省约 20% token，JSON 类内容可省 60–95% 且答案不变，示例中 55957 token 的 prompt 被压到 24340 token，关键的 FATAL 行仍逐字节保留。适合在意 token 成本或上下文长度上限的 agent 开发者。
items.summary_en: Headroom is a context compression layer that shrinks tool output, logs, files and RAG chunks before they reach the LLM, available as a library, a proxy and an MCP server. The project reports roughly 20% fewer tokens for coding agents and 60-95% for JSON with unchanged answers; its demo compresses a 55,957-token prompt to 24,340 tokens while a critical FATAL line survives byte for byte. Aimed at agent developers paying per token or fighting context limits.
